metadata.title: Lactobacillaceae 16S rRNA of Melipona favosa honey (Venezuela) reclassified with full-length 16S recovered from stingless bee MAGs and genomes

creators.name: Sélem-Mojica, Nelly
creators.affiliation: Centro de Ciencias Matemáticas, UNAM Morelia

creators.name: Vit, Patricia
creators.affiliation: Apitherapy and Bioactivity, Food Science Department, Universidad de Los Andes (APIBA-ULA), Mérida, Venezuela

metadata.description:
Inputs and results of Chapter 6 (Melipona favosa honey, Paraguaná, Venezuela). 16S rRNA V4 ASVs of sample B-VEN-D9 (10MFH) are classified against GTDB r226 plus full-length 16S rRNA recovered from metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) and isolate genomes of Mexican stingless bee honeys (Clades 1-4, Xolalpa-Aroche et al. 2026), and placed on a Lactobacillaceae 16S tree constrained by the GTDB genome topology.

chapter06-inputs.tar.gz keeps the data/ layout used by the code (vit/, ours/, refs/; see data/manifest.tsv in the GitHub repository). vit/: subset of the APIBA 16S dataset for B-VEN-D9 (full dataset: 10.5281/zenodo.20481566). ours/: 16S rRNA recovered from metagenomes (phyloFlash) and linked to MAGs (MarkerMAG), and barrnap 16S from MAGs and genomes (MAGs: 10.5281/zenodo.18446951). GTDB r226 SSU is not redeposited; the code downloads it from GTDB.
